about.title: About Me
about.content: Currently working as an Infrastructure Engineer at Randstad. I am a Kyoto based Linux System Engineer of around 10 years, with experience building and managing infrastructure in AWS and GCP. This site is showcase of my Terraform infrastructure projects, and collected place for contact information.

highlights: Handled infrastructure build and configuration for GCP-based Vertex AI PoC Lab.
Spearheaded cost reduction initiatives in AWS environment to reduce monthly billing by 25%.
Negotiated vendor purchases and contracts on behalf of UK universities.
Worked with Terraform and Progress Chef to build self-service platform for infra stack deployment.
Built automated monthly reporting extraction from RDS and self-hosted database sources.
Handled technical remediations and pentest scheduling for companies PCI accreditation.
Graduate role in small but skilled team of penetration testing specialists.
Built a solid foundation in both Linux and security concepts on the whole.
